items.raw_excerpt: More than 80 traffic officers have been deployed to check buses and other vehicles.
items.summary_en: South Africa's KwaZulu-Natal province is stepping up road safety checks ahead of the Annual Reed Dance. More than 80 traffic officers will inspect buses and other vehicles. The checks are meant to keep travelers safe during the big cultural event.
items.summary_ko: 남아프리카공화국 크와줄루나탈 주가 연례 움랑가 축제를 앞두고 도로 안전 점검을 강화하고 있습니다. 80명이 넘는 교통 단속 요원이 버스와 다른 차량을 검문하게 됩니다. 이번 점검은 큰 문화 행사 기간에 여행자들의 안전을 지키기 위한 것입니다.
items.title_en: KZN tightens road safety checks before Annual Reed Dance
items.title_ko: 크와줄루나탈, 움랑가 축제 앞두고 도로 안전 점검 강화
items.title_original: KZN intensifies road safety checks ahead of Annual Reed Dance

items.raw_excerpt: After a decade of delays, cost blow-outs and disruption to business and commuters, Auckland's City Rail Link (CRL) is finally due to open this weekend.
items.summary_en: After more than 100 years of planning and a decade of construction delays, Auckland's City Rail Link is opening this weekend. The new railway line will connect Auckland's city center with the surrounding suburbs.
items.summary_ko: 100년 이상의 계획과 10년간의 공사 지연 끝에 오클랜드 시티 레일 링크가 이번 주말 개통됩니다. 이 새 철도 노선은 오클랜드 시내와 주변 지역을 연결할 예정입니다.
items.title_en: Auckland's City Rail Link Finally Opens This Weekend
items.title_ko: 오클랜드 시티 레일 링크 드디어 이번 주말 개통
items.title_original: Why it took over a century for Auckland to get its CRL

items.raw_excerpt: While Amsterdam may be the center of the Dutch tech ecosystem, Groningen is developing its own startup community that expats love.
items.summary_en: While Amsterdam is the center of the Dutch tech scene, Groningen is growing its own startup community. Expats are moving there and loving the city. The northern city is becoming a quiet rival to Amsterdam for tech talent.
items.summary_ko: 암스테르담이 네덜란드 기술 생태계의 중심이지만, 그로닝겐은 자체 스타트업 커뮤니티를 키우고 있습니다. 외국인들이 그로닝겐으로 이주해 도시를 사랑하고 있습니다. 이 북부 도시는 기술 인재를 놓고 암스테르담의 조용한 경쟁자가 되고 있습니다.
items.title_en: Why Groningen is the coolest tech city you've never heard of
items.title_ko: 그로닝겐이 여러분이 모르는 가장 멋진 기술 도시인 이유
items.title_original: Why Groningen is the coolest tech city you’ve never heard of - The Next Web

items.raw_excerpt: In a red-hot property market where cash is usually king, Karli Bryant was outbid by $60,000 on a 116-year-old railway cottage. Then the owner read her letter.
items.summary_en: In a hot property market, Karli Bryant was outbid by $60,000 on a 116-year-old railway cottage. Instead of the highest bid, the owner chose her heartfelt letter. Karli finally got the home she had dreamed of.
items.summary_ko: 뜨거운 부동산 시장에서 캘리 브라이언트는 116년 된 철도 코티지 입찰에서 6만 달러 차이로 밀렸습니다. 그런데 최고가가 아닌 캘리의 진심 어린 편지를 읽은 집주인이 캘리에게 집을 주기로 했습니다. 캘리는 마침내 꿈꾸던 집을 차지하게 되었습니다.
items.title_en: Outbid by $60k, Karli won her dream home with a heartfelt letter
items.title_ko: 6만 달러 차이로 밀렸지만 진심 어린 편지 한 통으로 꿈의 집을 얻은 캘리
items.title_original: Outbid by $60k, Karli won her dream home with a heartfelt letter

items.raw_excerpt: VIT Chennai – The Hindu Biotech Conclave will offer a closer look at the latest developments, emerging opportunities and diverse career pathways in biotechnology
items.summary_en: VIT Chennai is hosting The Hindu Biotech Conclave to explore the latest developments in biotechnology. The event will highlight emerging career pathways and opportunities in the life sciences field.

items.summary_en: A pizza place called Spacca Napoli in Porto is getting attention. Locals are asking if it makes the best pizza in the city. It is a small food spot that people love to talk about.
